historic_inputs: Frozen common-support labels and saved scores, aligned to 29104 memberships and validated global sequence groups
policy_1: ceil(0.8*n) by q=max(p,1-p); label-blind fractional boundary ties
uncertainty: 10000 shared sequence-component block-bootstrap replicates, policies reselected each replicate, pointwise percentile 95%, degenerate/invalid intervals labelled
random_reference: label-blind random retention at equal realized coverage; expected error equals full-set error, expected positive retention equals coverage, expected final detection equals coverage*full recall
transfer: six leave-one-source-out folds; held-out source labels never used to pick thresholds; remove entire global near-sequence components found in held-out source from development; equal weight each development source
transfer_select: largest source-balanced coverage with pooled source-balanced observed error<=5%, deterministic low-threshold tie break; if none eligible report no_feasible_policy (no relaxation)
transfer_uncertainty: 10000 bootstrap development and held-source group resamples; identical seeded group draws across models within a fold; refit threshold per replicate; infeasible policies and invalid denominators remain NA
